title: Manchester City v Fulham: Relief Without Conviction at the Etihad
body:
They were held to a 1-1 draw by Fulham at the Etihad Stadium [S1].

BBC Sport's player ratings picked out Anderson and Berge as the standouts [S2].

The form numbers tell the sharper story. Manchester City's last five league matches brought two wins, no draws, three defeats, six points, eight goals scored and eight conceded [ST1]. Fulham's last five produced two wins, two draws, one defeat, eight points, five scored and four conceded [ST2].

The visitors have been the steadier outfit, and their tight defence over that spell is the quiet story of the run. The hosts have been trading goals and points at an uncomfortable rate, which makes a stalemate feel like a win for the wrong side.

This was the kind of game that tells you more about character than tactics. Results like this shape a season far more than any press conference ever will.

The Touchline Take: a point apiece, and nobody fully satisfied.
